title: Personal: talking to a landlord about the flat

lines.text: Hello, I am calling about the heater in the flat, it stopped working last week.
Yes, I got your message. It is an old unit.
lines.name: Mr Hale

lines.text: I pay 2300 a month, so I would like the heater working before the cold weeks.
I will send a technician to fix the heater by next week.
lines.name: Mr Hale

lines.text: If the technician says it must be replaced, who pays for the new one?
I would need to see the report first.
lines.name: Mr Hale

lines.text: I will send you photos of the damage tonight so you have them.
Good. By the way your lease ends in two months.
lines.name: Mr Hale

lines.text: I know. My deposit is 4600 and I want to be sure it stays safe if I extend.
Of course. Would you like to stay longer?
lines.name: Mr Hale

lines.text: Yes, I would like to extend the lease for six months with the same rent.
That is fine for me, I will not raise the rent this time.
lines.name: Mr Hale

lines.text: Thank you, that is a relief.
